editorial_review.scope: English text, readable setting, distinct exploratory topics; not owner acceptance or source availability verification.

reference.independence_statement: Independent-topic rows were authored as a separate exploration rather than expansions of seed tags or SLOP prompts. The implementation author has seen the seed; this is not a blind independent human corpus.
limitations: A finite purposive corpus, not the universe of visual subjects.
36 independent-topic probes and 12 seed-derived controls are reported separately.
No candidate is approved for the operational catalogue; no search or generation is authorized.
Microscopy and astronomy probe representation boundaries; their editorial admissibility requires owner review.

pca.caveat: 2D proximity is not original distance; equal eigenvalues allow rotated axes. No map gaps imply objective missing topics.

clustering.caveat: Exploratory parameter grid; noise is valid and no cluster is mandatory. Pair Jaccard excludes noise and is null when no positive co-cluster pairs exist.

coverage.caveat: Distances and radii describe this reference corpus only; they do not authorize or reject image acquisition.

random_baseline.caveat: Compare tag-only and random at the same budget. Full-catalog distances can only improve as rows are added; that comparison does not establish selection quality.
